# Hand-curated field names of game class: # into private/symbols/fields.csv by tools/rtti_scan.py with source "manual". type is a Ghidra

name: m_SkinHash
note): template hash of the current skin, spawned as the player (dev_skins.cpp)

name: m_pCameraMatrix
note): camera matrix copied into the VectorCamera (camera/free_camera.cpp)

name: m_ppInputMap
note): pointer to the pointer of the input map, **(this+52) (free_camera.cpp)

name: m_pHitpoints
note): current hitpoints; AdjustHitpoints adds the delta (dev/dev_cheats.cpp)

name: m_pMaxHitpoints
note): AdjustHitpoints clamps the hitpoints to it

name: m_pHitpointsFraction
note): AdjustHitpoints writes hitpoints / max (0 when dead)

name: m_SkinToDisplay
note): ESkin shown on the skin screen (dev/dev_skins.cpp)

name: m_NameEntryFlags
note): bit 0x80 = name entry DONE, node 96 takes exit 97 (save_screens.cpp)

name: m_State
note): cutscene state machine 0-7, changed by SetState (settings/skip_cinematics.cpp)

name: m_pPage
note): the name entry page, sprites found from it (settings/save_screens.cpp)

name: m_pArrowLeft
note): left arrow of the letter wheel (settings/save_screens.cpp)

name: m_pArrowRight
note): right arrow of the letter wheel (settings/save_screens.cpp)

name: m_Flags
note): bit 0x80 = cutscene done, set by SetState 7 (settings/skip_cinematics.cpp)

name: m_SlotIndex
note): chosen save slot, -1 when playing without saving (game_options.cpp)

name: m_apManagers
note): managers by index, game::GetManager(i) = this+28+4*i: 1=ActorManager 2=AIManager 4=CameraManager 5=CollisionManager 6=FrontendManager 7=InputManager 12=RenderManager 13=SaveGameManager 14=ScriptManager 15=SoundManager 18=CinematicsManager 20=WorldManager (NOTES.md, free_camera.cpp)

name: m_apLevels
note): array of level object pointers (count at +316; name at level+32) (direct_boot.cpp)

name: m_PlayerOneControllerIndex
note): user index of the pad that is player 1 (kernel/pad_slots.cpp)

name: m_ErrorMode
note): error mode, 2 = raise the error and wait for a reply (NOTES.md)

name: m_ErrorPending
note): set by RaiseError while an error is pending (runtime/NOTES.md)

name: m_ErrorRequest
note): the request that raised the error (runtime/NOTES.md)

name: m_Fov
note): FOV given to SetFOV, returned by GetFOV (camera/hor_plus.cpp)

name: m_Aspect
note): aspect given to SetFOV, returned by GetFOV (camera/hor_plus.cpp)

name: m_SidePlanes
note): frustum side planes as 8 floats, left/right/bottom/top (hor_plus.cpp)

name: m_CameraToWorld
note): 4x4 camera to world matrix, rows right/up/forward/pos (free-camera.md)

name: m_bMatricesValid
note): 0 = rebuild the matrices from the vectors (camera/free_camera.cpp)

name: m_AspectScale
note): factor of the derived aspect: +212 * aspect * display (hor_plus.cpp)

name: m_SelectionTime
note): time since the selection, zeroed by SetSelection (runtime/NOTES.md)

name: m_Flags
note): bit 0x40 passed to item mark vf64; bit 0x80 wraps and skips unselectable (NOTES.md)

name: m_TileRects
note): 3 D3DRECT tile rects of the per-tile resolves (gpu/tiling_hooks.cpp)

name: m_bTilingActive
note): set by vf04 when BeginTiling runs (gpu/tiling_hooks.cpp)

name: m_pLuaState
note): the lua_State of the game scripts (dev/dev_tools.cpp)
